## Workbook
### Sheet: Sheet1 overview (rows 1-2, cols A-C)
	A	B	C
1	DEE	2046 days, 17:30:00	49122
2	DEF	2055 days, 11:58:00	

## Answer range
Sheet: active sheet
Cells: C1:C2
2 graded cells — literals or short formulas are both fine.
